assessment.rationale: No open or discoverable solution puts first-aid and diagnostic kits in 2,000,000,000 households, so the Main KPI is not met. Household kit ownership is low even where surveyed (24.7% in a Sichuan household study, https://bmcpublichealth.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s12889-024-19376-y), and the largest household-kit programmes found are single-condition: ColaLife's Kit Yamoyo diarrhoea kit in Zambia (a 452,000-kit public order, https://grandchallenges.ca/grantee-stars/0144-01) and HIV self-test distribution such as ATLAS (about 400,000 kits in three West African countries, https://atlas.solthis.org/en/). A combined multi-disease home test kit for LMIC households is still at trial stage (DASH Phase II, not yet recruiting, https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06588790). Open hardware covers pieces only, for example a 3D-printed lateral-flow reader (github.com/fpaskali/LFApp). Honest limit: first-aid kits and rapid tests are commodities; the unsolved part is a low-cost, usable combined kit with resupply at household scale, and tasks that only re-specify a standard first-aid kit are not new work.

additionalSearches.query: household first aid kit ownership low-income countries survey percentage households
additionalSearches.finding: No national survey of household kit ownership in low-income countries found; a Sichuan household survey found only 24.7% stocked a first-aid kit.

additionalSearches.query: home diagnostic kit distribution programme households malaria HIV self-test millions distributed
additionalSearches.finding: Combined household rapid tests (malaria, HIV, pregnancy) are only in the planned DASH Phase II trial (2,250 households). HIV self-test programmes like ATLAS distributed about 400,000 kits.

additionalSearches.query: open source low-cost home diagnostic device github multi-test kit smartphone
additionalSearches.finding: Open designs exist for parts (open lateral-flow reader with CAD on GitHub, smartphone oximeter, echOpen probe), not a complete household first-aid and diagnostic kit.

additionalSearches.query: Kit Yamoyo ColaLife diarrhoea kit households reached
additionalSearches.finding: Kit Yamoyo (ORS+zinc) raised correct diarrhoea treatment from under 1% to 45% in a Zambian trial; Ministry ordered 452,000 kits. Single-condition, one country.
